source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Interior door heights (2.1m) assumed, not separately dimensioned on plan.
West door head height assumed equal to adjacent window head (2.6m) pending elevation confirmation.
Partition/corridor wall thickness taken as labelled 240mm/250mm even though thin-line pixel width measured smaller; centerlines used for partitions per dimension chains.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.
Bottom-row partition positions approximated as equal 3750mm quarter bays; the bottom dimension sub-chain was partly illegible at available resolution.
Bottom-row door positions approximated near room centers pending a clearer wall-support crop.
South-wall small window widths approximated as 1200mm centered per row pattern seen on South elevation.
Opening z heights are provisional pending elevation claim confirmation for the upper storey (z_floor=3.0, ceiling 3.6m).

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.

This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound direct original returns from view_image or paired elevation views are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Use-basis records saved; unresolved inferences remain explicit.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

decision.reason: North elevation storey chain (1000/1600/1000) clearly gives 1F exterior window sill=1.0m/head=2.6m, matching all 1F room windows already modeled at this value.

claims.reason: North_view.png left-side dimension chain for the ground-floor storey reads, floor-to-floor bottom-up: 1000 (sill above 1F floor, z=0), 1600 (window height), 1000 (head to underside of 2F floor slab), totalling the 3000mm 1F storey height. This chain applies to all ground-floor exterior windows on the same storey (both long-wall office/room windows and the east gable corridor window), since none is shown with a distinct sill/head elsewhere.
unresolved: F1:W_B1 is narrower (1200mm vs 2400mm) than the other 1F windows but is on the same wall/storey; same sill/head assumed, not separately dimensioned in the elevation for that narrower window.

decision.reason: North elevation storey chain (1000/1800/800) gives 2F exterior window sill=4.0m/head=5.8m absolute, matching all 2F windows already modeled at this value.

claims.reason: North_view.png left-side dimension chain for the upper-floor storey reads, floor-to-floor bottom-up: 1000 (sill above 2F floor, z=3.0 absolute), 1800 (window height), 800 (head to roof/parapet), totalling the 3600mm 2F storey height. Applied to all 2F exterior windows (conference-room windows, small office windows, and both gable corridor windows) since none shows a distinct sill/head elsewhere.
unresolved: F2:W_B1-4 are narrower than F2:W_C1/C2 but on the same storey wall; same sill/head assumed.

decision.reason: South elevation shows the main entrance door/transom as a distinct taller glazed symbol with its own 1500/900/600 chain, giving a 0-2.4m opening, taller than the 2.1m placeholder originally assumed.

claims.reason: South_view.png left-side dimension chain for the ground-floor storey (below the door/window row) reads, floor-to-floor bottom-up: 1500, 900, 600, totalling 3000mm. The door graphic (tall glazed double-leaf symbol) occupies the lower two segments (1500+900=2400mm) with 600mm of wall above to the underside of the 2F floor slab, unlike the plain windows on the same elevation whose own chain instead reads 1000/1600/1000. Combined door+transom opening height taken as 0 to 2400mm.
unresolved: The split between a 1500mm door leaf and 900mm transom above it (vs. a single continuous 2400mm door) is not separately confirmed; treated here as one opening 0-2.4m.
